fib: ______ is a systematic classical theory of economic development which is based on the existence of two sectors in the economy of developing countries-the modern and the traditional sectors.
Arthur Lewis
Arthur Lewis is a systematic classical theory of economic development which is based on the existence of two sectors in the economy of developing countries- the modern and the traditional sectors.
______ is an early model of economic growth used in the field of development economics to explain an economy's growth rate in terms of level of saving and productivity of capital.
Harrod-Domar model
The Harrod-Domar model is an early model of economic growth used in the field of development economics to explain an economy's growth rate in terms of level of saving and productivity of capital.
______ is a country that is characterized by mass poverty not caused by temporal misfortune but by wrong and obsolete methods of utilizing of available resources.
undeveloped country
An undeveloped country is a country that is characterized by mass poverty not caused by temporal misfortune but by wrong and obsolete methods of utilizing of available resources.
______ means that people cooperate to do different works as these works are broken down into small parts, each undertaken by different workers.
Division of labour
Division of labour means that people cooperate to do different works as these works are broken down into small parts, each undertaken by different workers.
______ are the factors that act as constraints to development in less developed countries.
obstacles to development
The obstacles to development are the factors that act as constraints to development in less developed countries.
______ is an indicator that takes into consideration the economic and non-economic factors of human lives.
Human development index
The Human development index is an indicator that takes into consideration the economic and non-economic factors of human lives.
______ is the brain behind the success of any business enterprise and this makes him/her an important factor necessary for the overall economic growth.
Entrepreneur
An Entrepreneur is the brain behind the success of any business enterprise and this makes him/her an important factor necessary for the overall economic growth.
______ is a linear function of capital.
model where output
The model uses a linear model where output is a linear function of capital.
______ is considered to be developed if it has a high level of industrialization, a sophisticated economy, and a high standard of living.
country
A country is considered to be developed if it has a high level of industrialization, a sophisticated economy, and a high standard of living.
______ are the most essential factors in the process of economic growth, because even capital accumulation is not possible without technical progress.
technological changes
Technological Progress The technological changes are the most essential factors in the process of economic growth, because even capital accumulation is not possible without technical progress.
______ is an important economic goal because it means there is more material abundance brought about by efficient management of scarce resources.
Growth
Growth is an important economic goal because it means there is more material abundance brought about by efficient management of scarce resources.
______ is the sustainable increase in the total amount of the goods and services (output) produced in an economy over time.
Economic growth
Economic growth is the sustainable increase in the total amount of the goods and services (output) produced in an economy over time.
